complexity.instructions: A customer ticket asks a motor-insurance claims desk to decide a claim (approve, partial, deny or need more information) and the payout. How hard is it to decide this claim correctly?

criteria.simple: one clear situation; a single rule decides it; at most one simple calculation
criteria.moderate: a payout calculation with a deductible or a fault share, or one exclusion to check
criteria.complex: several interacting conditions: exclusions or licence/authorisation questions, caps or total loss, conflicting or missing documents or amounts, late reporting, unusual parties

needs_calculation.instructions: Does deciding this claim require calculating a payout amount?

missing_information.instructions: Is information or a document needed to decide this claim missing?
